conviction_note: Three prints as a public company, all down and all large (-11.83%, -21.27%, -19.11%, median 19.11%, zero up), into a stock the corpus says has rallied 75% since mid-June - a move the baseline's 5-day and 20-day windows (-1.22% and -2.34%) completely conceal - and which drew a downgrade for exactly that reason; about a fifth of the median, negative, with a very wide band because a 75%-vol recent IPO can gap either way.

findings.finding: Mizuho downgraded Netskope on 2026-08-19 explicitly on a '75% rally since mid-June' - a move invisible in the baseline, whose run-up fields show only -1.22% over five days and -2.34% over twenty - so this stock enters a print it has fallen 12% to 21% on three times out of three having roughly doubled off its June level, with the corpus's retail base positioned long and adding.

findings.why_not_priced: The specific thing the market is not holding in view is the size of the base effect. Anyone anchoring on the twenty-day run-up sees a flat stock going into the print; the actual position is a name that has roughly doubled since mid-June and is still 46.68% below its 52-week high, so both the bull and the bear can point at a chart and the crowd has settled on the bull reading. Three consecutive double-digit negative reactions at a September-2025 IPO is the signature of a company whose prints keep landing against expectations that have run ahead of them, and nothing in the capture suggests the pattern has been re-underwritten: there is no sell-side preview, no consensus figure and no company disclosure of any kind in August. The band is very wide and crosses zero because the corpus also carries a genuine positive read-through - CrowdStrike and Okta both reported well in late August and Zscaler reports alongside - and because a 46%-discounted name at 75% realised vol can squeeze hard.
findings.independence: From a different part of the corpus and pointing the other way, which is why the upside band is open: a 2026-08-27 message records 'CRWD and OKTA posted the great earnings report, AI Security is the real cash cow', and a 2026-08-26 message notes a Boston Scientific cyber breach as a sector catalyst. Nothing in the filings index corroborates or contradicts the finding - August 2026 contains only a SCHEDULE 13G/A on 2026-08-14.
